file_reasoning: Live dispatch board, driver roster and nested management overlays.

resource_binding_reasoning.reasoning: Real board state summary and labeled refresh, directory permission visibility. Fixed320 driver panel plus board column widths leaves address star constrained at smaller screens.

Rows show order/status, customer+phone/address, assigned driver, amount collection, payment warning and elapsed. Customer horizontal StackPanel can measure unbounded TextBlock despite Wrap, requiring native test.

Buttons strictly shown New→MarkReady, Ready→assign, OutForDelivery→outcome. No action for Preparing/Assigned/HandedToDriver in this markup. Whether these statuses reachable requires server path review, not inferred from comment that all legal transitions offered.
Textual PaymentStateLabel plus warning color avoids conflating collected with unconfirmed transfer. Collection amount remains server DTO display, not recalculated by XAML.
Driver list buttons pass actual driver to root, async account/stat consistency must hold across rapid selection/close; prior VM generation candidate applies.

Success text unwrapped white on themedTextPrimary, so long notes and dark mode risk overflow/low contrast. Error wraps420. Dispatch modals then directory layered last, requiring VM mutual exclusion/focus control.
